test a weighted combination over the full pool using inverse_error weights to see if including weaker but complementary models helps, given the trend dominated regime.
Test a weighted combination with softmax_neg_error to see if a sharper weighting improves over inverse_error for this trend-dominated, high-predictability series.
The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a simple mean may capture diverse errors better than weighted.
Try a weighted combo on the smaller, more stable pool4 using softmax_neg_error weights to emphasize top performers while reducing variance due to only 3 windows.
Try a DBA combination on the full pool to see if a deterministic blend improves over weighted inverse on this trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models that still score well.
The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a median combination may reduce influence of outliers and highly correlated models.
Test a per‑horizon weighted approach using the top‑k mean per horizon (w6) on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over global weighted.
The series is trend‑dominated with high predictability; a simple mean over a focused, high‑quality pool (pool4) may capture diverse errors better than weighted combos.
test a different kind of strategy – a dba combination on the reduced pool4 to see if a more targeted weighted averaging improves over the best weighted.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.4322. Series context: trend strength 0.9274 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.407); 14 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 26.588.
